_notes.explorerUrl: Base address of the public explorer (the prototype's hash routes are appended after '#'). While it is null, explorer names are written as plain text and each page says the explorer is not online yet.
_notes.markdownCopy: Where readers can read these pages as plain Markdown on GitHub. Change it when the guidebook moves to the main branch.
_notes.gitbookCookies: GitBook's own cookie statement, quoted on the privacy page. Re-read it before each launch.
